limits: The sequence callbacks exercise intentional repeated sends without a responding peer; libcoap may wait five seconds on each later initial-exchange send. This is not a production-owner cleanup test.
Only process crash and syscall failures are exercised; no physical power-loss or hardware claim.
Filesystem preservation is a consumer obligation; deleting or rolling back an entire valid registry cannot be cryptographically detected.
Production Port owner, bounded IPC/credit, live replay, same-stack OSCORE exchanges, native Mix builds and complete software matrix remain unaccepted.
